How's the weather today?

Delhi is currently around 93 °F (34 °C) with cloudy skies and some sunshine in the afternoon, light winds and high humidity.

I mean I can use ten built‑in functions—like searching the web, opening sites, generating text or images, playing media, reading email, managing calendar events, and accessing Drive files.
Hello, Jarvis.

Perfect.

No, no, its downloading.

No in the Windows Update.
I'll go to Windows Update and click the download button for the additional update now. Let me know once it starts.

What the **** is wrong with you? I want you to go and download the latest update available on the Windows Update. Like I can see that there is another update available. You have downloaded one update, I want you to download the next update.
